chunks: And Zurarah reported it from one of his companions, raising it (to the Prophet), he said:
The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'Al-Thareed is blessed.'

key_terms.الثَّرِيدُ: A dish made of bread soaked in broth or meat sauce, often considered a blessed or beneficial food.
key_terms.رَفَعَهُ: Rafa'ahu; a technical term in hadith sciences meaning the narrator elevated the statement to the Prophet, implying it is a prophetic saying rather than just an Imam's.

ai.seo_question: What is the religious significance of Al-Thareed in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Transmitted by Zurara, a key link in the chain of transmission for Kufan scholars, this hadith from al-Kafi elevates Al-Thareed—a dish of bread soaked in broth or meat juice—as a symbol of divine blessing (baraka). This narration reflects the Shia emphasis on the Prophet’s practical wisdom regarding simple, nourishing foods that sustain both physical health and spiritual gratitude, reinforcing the sanctity of everyday sustenance.

en.hubeali: And one of our companions reported it, raising it, said,
